courses.title: Export Readiness for African SMEs
courses.description:
A practical first course for small and medium-sized businesses getting ready to sell across borders.

You will work through a readiness checklist covering product, pricing, paperwork and partners, using real examples from exporters in Nigeria, Ghana and Kenya.

- Assess whether your business is export-ready
- Build a simple export plan
- Understand what buyers and customs will ask for
courses.eligibility: Open to founders and managers of registered SMEs
outcomes: Score your business against an export-readiness checklist
Choose a first target market using trade data
Know which documents a first shipment needs

courses.title: Data for Development: Intro to SQL
courses.description:
Learn to query real development datasets with SQL. No prior coding experience needed.

Each lesson uses open data on health, trade and education from across the continent, so you practise on the kind of questions programme teams actually ask.
outcomes: Write SELECT queries with filters and sorting
Join tables and summarise with GROUP BY

courses.title: Leading Distributed Teams
courses.description:
How to lead teams spread across countries, time zones and cultures.

Covers rituals, written communication, trust-building and performance conversations, with case studies from pan-African organisations and diaspora-led startups.
courses.eligibility: For people who manage or are about to manage a team
outcomes: Design a weekly operating rhythm for a remote team

courses.title: Carbon Finance Fundamentals
courses.description:
An introduction to carbon markets and climate finance for African projects.

You will learn how credits are created, verified and sold, what makes a project bankable, and where the opportunities and risks are for founders and investors.
courses.access_conditions: Included with Charter Center Pro membership (paid); sign in on Charter Center to enrol
outcomes: Explain compliance and voluntary carbon markets
Estimate credit revenue for a small project

courses.title: Pitching to Diaspora Investors
courses.description:
Craft a pitch that lands with diaspora angel investors and networks.

Covers what diaspora investors look for, how to structure a short deck, and how to follow up after the first meeting.
courses.eligibility: Open to founders with a registered or soon-to-be registered business
outcomes: Tell your story in a two-minute pitch
Answer the five questions investors always ask

courses.title: Product Management in Emerging Markets
courses.description:
An advanced course for product managers building for users on low-bandwidth networks, shared devices and mobile money.

Includes discovery in the field, pricing for informal economies, and shipping with small teams.
courses.eligibility: For product managers with at least two years' experience
courses.access_conditions: Included with Charter Center Pro membership (paid); sign in on Charter Center to enrol
outcomes: Run user research in low-connectivity settings
Prioritise a roadmap with limited engineering capacity
Design for USSD, SMS and offline-first apps
Measure product-market fit in informal markets

courses.title: Mobile Money & Payments APIs
courses.description:
Integrate mobile money and card payments into your product.

Hands-on lessons with sandbox APIs, webhooks and reconciliation, plus the regulatory basics for handling payments in several markets.
outcomes: Accept a mobile money payment through an API
Handle webhooks and failed payments safely

courses.title: Grant Writing That Wins
courses.description:
Write grant proposals that funders want to fund.

From reading a call for proposals to building a logframe and budget, with annotated examples of winning applications.
outcomes: Decode what a funder is really asking for
Write a clear problem statement and theory of change
Avoid the ten most common rejection reasons

courses.title: AfCFTA Rules of Origin Explained
courses.description: A short, focused course on the African Continental Free Trade Area's rules of origin and how they decide whether your goods qualify for lower tariffs.
outcomes: Explain wholly obtained and sufficiently processed goods
Apply value-added thresholds to a product

courses.title: Exporter en Afrique de l’Ouest : douanes et logistique
courses.description:
Un cours pratique pour les entreprises qui veulent vendre dans l’espace CEDEAO et UEMOA.

Dédouanement, transport routier et maritime, assurances et paiements : chaque leçon s’appuie sur des cas réels au Sénégal, en Côte d’Ivoire et au Bénin.
outcomes: Choisir un transitaire et un incoterm
Calculer le coût rendu d’une expédition

courses.title: Politiques publiques et transformation numérique
courses.description: Comment les États africains conçoivent et mettent en œuvre leurs stratégies numériques : identité numérique, données publiques, cybersécurité et inclusion.
courses.eligibility: Destiné aux agents publics, chercheurs et membres de la société civile
courses.access_conditions: Accès payant ; tarif réduit pour les agents publics
outcomes: Analyser une stratégie nationale du numérique
Rédiger une note de politique publique

courses.title: Kilimo Kinachostahimili Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi
courses.description: Kozi fupi kwa wakulima wadogo na maafisa ugani kuhusu mbinu za kilimo zinazostahimili ukame na mvua zisizotabirika.
outcomes: Kupanga msimu kwa kutumia taarifa za hali ya hewa

courses.title: Uongozi wa Vijana katika Jamii
courses.description: Kozi ya utangulizi kwa vijana wanaotaka kuongoza miradi ya kijamii katika jamii zao.
courses.eligibility: Kwa vijana wenye umri wa miaka 18 hadi 35

courses.title: Community Health Data Essentials
courses.description: A 30-minute primer on collecting and using community health data responsibly, for health workers and programme staff.
outcomes: Protect patient privacy in the field
Turn tallies into a monthly summary

courses.title: Health Systems Financing in Africa
courses.description:
A rigorous 12-hour course on how African health systems are financed — taxation, insurance, donor funding and private capital — and how to reform them.

**Includes** three case studies (Ghana NHIS, Rwanda Mutuelles, Nigeria BHCPF) and a final policy memo assessed by faculty.
courses.eligibility: Open to health-sector professionals with three or more years' experience
courses.access_conditions: Paid course; scholarships available for Charter Mission members
outcomes: Model the fiscal impact of an insurance scheme

courses.title: Cooperative Agribusiness: From Farm to Market
courses.description:
How farmer cooperatives can aggregate, process and sell to bigger buyers.

Covers governance, quality standards, warehouse receipts and contract farming.
courses.eligibility: For cooperative leaders and agribusiness staff
outcomes: Set up cooperative governance that lasts

courses.title: Introdução ao Financiamento de Startups
courses.description: Um curso introdutório sobre as opções de financiamento para startups em Angola, Moçambique e Cabo Verde: subsídios, business angels, capital de risco e dívida.
outcomes: Preparar uma tabela de capitalização simples

courses.title: ريادة الأعمال الرقمية في شمال أفريقيا
courses.description: دورة تمهيدية لرواد الأعمال في المغرب والجزائر وتونس ومصر حول بناء مشروع رقمي: من الفكرة إلى أول عميل.

paths.title: From idea to first export
paths.description: A guided path for founders selling across borders under AfCFTA — market research, certification, logistics and getting paid.

paths.title: Data and digital for development
paths.description: Build the data and product skills to design digital services that work for African users.

paths.title: Climate-smart enterprise
paths.description: From climate-resilient farming to carbon finance: build an enterprise that is ready for a changing climate.
